payload.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-23
payload.summary:
**Security and agent tooling stole the spotlight**; **OpenAI pushed GPT-5.5-Cyber, Codex Security, and Patch The Planet** while builders kept circling one question: how do you actually work with long-horizon coding agents day to day?; **Vercel landed two sharp moves** with Claude Design deployment and WebSocket support; **Box made HTML a first-class artifact** and Aaron Levie argued evals are the real control plane for enterprise AI.; Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex kept showing up in the trenches; the mood was less "wow, cool demo" and more "show me the workflow, the infra math, and the production path."

**安全和代码智能体今天最抢戏**；**OpenAI 一口气推了 GPT-5.5-Cyber、Codex Security 和 Patch The Planet**，讨论点也很直接：长时程 coding agent 到底该怎么真用起来；**Vercel 连出两招**，一边把 Claude Design 一键发到线上，一边补上 WebSocket；**Box 把 HTML 当成正式内容来管**，Aaron Levie 也把话挑明了，企业做 AI，最后拼的就是 evals。; Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 这几个名字反复出现；气氛已经不是看 demo 图个新鲜，而是盯着工作流、算力账和能不能上线。

sections.headline: **Anthropic's Mike Krieger says Fable 5 changes the job from prompting to delegation | Anthropic 的 Mike Krieger 说，Fable 5 把工作重心从提示词改成了委派**
sections.body:
On **AI & I by Every**, **Mike Krieger** describes **Claude Fable 5** as the first model that consistently holds long context, carries work overnight, and recovers when services fail. His main point is not raw intelligence but trust: he now hands the model complex tasks, expects it to scaffold around outages, and reviews the result in the morning.

He also says the workflow itself has changed. Instead of tiny back and forth prompts, he spends more time on architecture, intent, and planning documents, then runs several long sessions in parallel. The practical shift is stark: one fast, high context assistant for quick loops, and one deeper model for long horizon execution.

在 **AI & I by Every** 这期节目里，**Mike Krieger** 讲得很具体：**Claude Fable 5** 真正拉开的，不只是模型更强，而是它开始能稳稳接住长上下文、整夜跑任务，甚至在外部服务挂掉时自己想办法绕过去。重点不是“聪明”，而是“敢不敢交给它做”。他现在会把复杂任务整段委派出去，第二天早上再回来验收。

他还提到，工作方式已经变了。以前是来回抠 prompt，现在更多时间花在架构、意图和前期规划上，再把任务分给多个长会话并行推进。说白了，就是一边留一个高上下文、反应快的助手处理短回路，一边让更重的模型去啃长任务。

sections.headline: **Swyx** argues the model-lab-plus-neocloud combo is the real compute power play | **Swyx** 认为，模型实验室加新云的组合，才是现在最狠的算力打法
sections.body:
i dont think anyone is correctly doing the math around how SpaceX, the NeoCloud+NeoLab, is currently going to market?

SpaceX has already recouped about HALF its investment in Cursor, in compute deals. The other half is  paid for if Composer 3 does well. 

No other company is simultaneously a leading model lab + neocloud (at least where GPUs is concerned). its a crazy effective combo iff you've adequately planned out gpu supply if inhouse training 1) goes very well 2) doesn't go very well

我觉得现在还没人真正把账算明白：SpaceX 这个 NeoCloud+NeoLab 的组合，到底是怎么在市场上打的？

SpaceX 光靠算力交易，已经收回了投给 Cursor 的大概一半资金。另一半如果 Composer 3 表现不错，也能回本。

现在没有别的公司能同时做到头部模型实验室 + 新云服务商，至少在 GPU 这件事上没有。这种组合的效率高得离谱，前提是你真的把 GPU 供给规划好了，不管自研训练 1）进展特别顺，还是 2）进展没那么顺。

sections.headline: **Peter Yang** calls out ragebait clips about parenting and work | **Peter Yang** 点名批评拿育儿和工作做文章的 ragebait 切片
sections.body:
Ok I've fallen for the ragebaiting and have been triggered by this so I'm going to say this: 

Whether intentional or not, there's a lot of virality that comes from:

1. Pick the most ragebait moment of the conversation
2. Make a clip of that exact moment
3. Get tons of retweets and views

I can tell it's rage baiting (just like the Corgi founder clip) but here's the thing - if even one parent watches this clip and decides to neglect their kids more then the damage is done.

And yes it's hard to work at home when your kid comes back at 3 pm (or 1 pm with summer camp!) but we all make our choices.

行吧，我还是被这种 ragebait 钓到了，也确实被激到了，所以我得说一句：

不管是不是故意的，很多传播就是这么来的：

1. 挑对话里最容易惹火的那一刻
2. 单独把那一段剪出来
3. 拿到一堆转发和播放

我看得出这就是在钓情绪（跟那个 Corgi 创始人的片段一个路数），但问题在这儿：哪怕只有一个家长看了这个片段之后，决定更少管自己的孩子，那伤害就已经发生了。

没错，孩子下午 3 点回家（或者夏令营 1 点就结束）的时候，在家工作确实很难。但选择还是每个人自己做。

sections.headline: **Aaron Levie** says enterprise AI success comes down to evals | **Aaron Levie** 直说企业 AI 最后拼的就是 evals
sections.body:
Almost all AI model and agent progress is downstream from evals. Open weights post training for specific domains comes down to evals. Agent improvements in the applied AI layer is all about evals. Agentic enterprise deployments that actually can augment work is all about evals. It’s all evals.

This will become a core competency of any enterprise in the future. The companies that are able to best understand their own (and/or customers) workflows and how well agents participate in that work will be in the best position to actually drive real automation.

几乎所有 AI 模型和 agent 的进步，往下拆，最后都落在 evals 上。特定领域的开源权重后训练，关键是 evals。应用层的 agent 提升，关键是 evals。真正能增强工作的企业级 agent 部署，关键还是 evals。归根到底，全是 evals。

这以后会变成任何企业的核心能力。谁最懂自己（以及/或者客户）的工作流，最清楚 agent 在这些流程里到底做得怎么样，谁就最有机会真正把自动化做出来。
